title: Unemployment Adventure
welcome_lead: What happens when people can't find work? 📉

final_note: You learned what unemployment is, why it matters and what governments do.

walkthroughs.body_html:
You're unemployed if you can work, want to work, but can't find a job.

People in school or retired are not counted as unemployed.

Reasons include:

  • Recession — businesses close.
  • Skills mismatch — wrong skills for new jobs.
  • Automation — robots do the job.
  • Industry decline — coal, steel.

Government help includes:

  • Benefits — short-term money support.
  • Training — new skills.
  • Apprenticeships — learn-while-you-earn.

Lower unemployment = more spending, healthier economy. 🚀

mcqs.q: What does standard theory predict about a minimum wage?
options: If above equilibrium, it raises wages for those still employed but causes unemployment by reducing labour demand — though empirical evidence is mixed.
A minimum wage always reduces unemployment because workers have more money to spend.
A minimum wage is paid by the government.
Consumer surplus is the profit that consumers make.
